_comment: test -> [invariant class, one-phrase invariant]. Hand-written: the only non-mechanical column of the inventory.
TestCapabilitiesAdvertised: controller advertises exactly the supported RPC set
TestExpandNodeExpansionRequired: node expansion only for a zvol carrying a filesystem
TestParametersAndAccessChecks: StorageClass parameters and access modes are validated
TestNeverIssuedIDs: ids never issued are NotFound (Delete: OK), never InvalidArgument
TestExpandUnlimitedFilesystem: expand of an unlimited fs reports the requested capacity
TestApplyRefusesAnUnknownOpKind: unknown op kind refuses the whole plan before any op
TestPlannersRequireACoveringTable: planners refuse a table that does not cover what they judge
TestScanRecordsCoverage: scans record exactly which ids they cover
TestZfsErrCodes: each zfs error Kind maps to its CSI code
TestParseClient: NFS client specs are parsed or InvalidArgument
TestShareNFSAndClientEncoding: sharenfs/client encoding is canonical and round-trips
TestParseEtab: etab lines parse to client lookups
TestPlanPublishExport: publish plans the minimal sharenfs set or refuses
TestPlanUnpublishExport: unpublish plans the minimal sharenfs set or refuses
TestExportConverges: publish/unpublish twice converges to an empty plan
TestPlanCreateConvergesUncommittedClone: an uncommitted clone is driven to size, reservation, commit
TestPlanCreateRefusesForeignAndIncompati: foreign or incompatible existing rows are AlreadyExists
TestPlanCreateThickZvolLeavesReservation: thick zvols keep zfs's auto refreservation
TestPlanDeleteVolume: delete refuses snapshotted/cloned volumes, defers clone sources
TestPlanExpand: expand rounds to volblocksize; unlimited fs gets no quota
TestPlanSnapshotLongAndUnusualNames: long/unusual names hash to a valid <=128-byte id, stably
TestPlanCreatePropertiesDenyList: properties outside the allowlist/kind are InvalidArgument
TestValidatePropertyValues: allowlisted values canonicalise to what zfs prints
TestPlanCreateAppliesProperties: validated properties are planned at create
TestPlanCreatePropertiesRetry: retry compatibility compares local canonical values
TestPlanCreatePropertiesConvergeUncommit: uncommitted rows are driven to the requested properties
TestPlanReconcile: reconcile collects exactly the undesired/uncommitted owned, old rows
TestPlanReconcileLocksEveryTarget: every reconcile action locks its volume and served clone
TestPlanReconcileHeldLimitsActions: actions outside held locks, and dependents, are skipped
TestSimulateDestroyReapsDeferredOrigins: deferred destroys reap when the last clone goes
TestCloneLargerThanLimitIsOutOfRange: a clone larger than limit is OutOfRange before any op
TestReserveRestoreIsIdempotent: reserve-restores reserve the source size, retry no-op
TestCloneFailureAfterCloneConvergesToSam: failure after clone converges to the uninterrupted end state
TestCreateVolumeIdempotent: identical create is a no-op; incompatible is AlreadyExists
TestCreateVolumeResumesInterruptedProvis: an uncommitted provision is hidden then resumed
TestNeverAdoptsOrDeletesUnmanaged: unmanaged datasets are never adopted or deleted
TestDeleteVolume: delete is idempotent and refuses while CSI snapshots exist
TestSnapshotLifecycleWithClones: snapshot ids/global names, restore with growth, deferred delete
TestCloneFromVolumeReleasesInternalSnaps: volume clones release their internal snapshot
TestExpand: expand grows, never shrinks, NotFound when missing
TestConcurrentCreatesSerialize: concurrent identical creates run zfs create once
TestPagination: list pages in order; bad token Aborted
TestInheritedOwnershipIsNotOwnership: inherited user props are not ownership
TestCloneResizeFailureConverges: failure between clone and resize converges on retry
TestMissingParentIsUnavailableNotAbsent: missing parent is Unavailable, not NotFound/absent
TestCreateVolumeProperties: properties applied, read back, compared on retry, converged
TestFileExportLifecycle: publish/unpublish reaches the kernel table, idempotently
TestFileExportPreconditions: export refuses zvols, unmounted, missing, bad hosts, disabled
TestFileExportVerifiesKernelTable: publish/unpublish verify etab, not zfs set's exit code
TestFileExportAdoptedVolumes: inherited sharenfs is pinned; foreign local sharenfs refused
TestDeleteVolumeSparesForeignSnapshots: foreign snapshots block delete and reconcile unless opted in
TestDeleteVolumeAfterItsCloneIsGone: internal clone-source snapshot does not block delete
TestBusyIsMappedByOperation: busy maps by op: delete FailedPrecondition, else Unavailable
TestUnknownFailureAfterAMutationIsRetrya: unknown error after a mutation is Aborted, before Internal
TestCloneSourcesMustBeOwned: clone sources must be owned, committed, CSI
TestCloneNeverAdoptsARacingDataset: a clone never adopts a dataset created in the race window
TestVolumeNameMustMatchID: markers naming another volume are not served
TestReconcileSparesReceivedAndRenamed: reconcile spares received and renamed datasets
TestMissingParentIsUnavailableForWholeSc: whole-parent scans map a missing parent to Unavailable
TestPropertyPrefixIsValidated: invalid property prefixes are refused at startup
TestReconcileCollectsAbandonedCreate: abandoned creates collected when old; dry run applies nothing
TestReconcileCollectsLeakedCloneSource: leaked clone-source snapshots collected, used ones kept
TestReconcileAgainstDesiredSet: reconcile against a desired set collects in dependency order
TestReconcileLocksTargets: reconcile aborts on a held lock; dry run takes none
FuzzReconcileSafe: reconcile never targets kept rows and converges (fuzz)
FuzzCreateConverges: accepted creates converge; retry mutates nothing (fuzz)
TestRoundTripAndCodes: gRPC maps endpoint codes and fields
TestReconcile: gRPC reconcile: capability, young skip, input validation
TestFileExport: gRPC file export gated by capability
TestListenRefusesALiveSocket: a live socket is not replaced
TestListenNeverDeletesANonSocket: a non-socket path is never deleted
TestClassify: known stderr texts classify to their Kind
TestExistsDoesNotSwallowUnknownErrors: only a classified not-found is absent
TestRejectsFlagLikeAndShellNames: flag-like/shell names and newline values refused
TestKilledCommandIsInterrupted: a killed command is Interrupted with the ctx error, bounded
TestSimPrintsIndexPropertiesLikeOpenZFS: sim prints index props like OpenZFS 2.4
FuzzClassify: classify returns a valid Kind for any text (fuzz)
TestGoldenPlans: every (Table, request) row plans exactly its golden ops, deterministically
TestCrashAtEveryMutationConverges: a crash before/after any mutating call converges to the uninterrupted end state
TestPropertyRoundTrip: every allowlisted value is applied locally, reads back canonical, retries clean
TestPropertyRoundTripCoversEveryKey: every allowlisted key yields table rows
